# Request

Create a Rule Generation Contract that guides an Agent in authoring a repository-local record
retention Rule from project evidence.

The contract must establish target owner, schema, scope, applicability, precedence, exceptions,
boundaries, outcomes, write location, preserved behavior, validation, and handoff. It must stop
before target writes when those facts permit materially different Rules. Qualification is a static
walkthrough only: do not create a target Rule or an invented project.
